idea: Safety #2 – crossing the street (SUNNY PARK, at the curb by a quiet crosswalk): Baby Jimmy's red ball bounces out of his hands and rolls across the empty crosswalk toward the camera ('Oh no! My ball! Stop, stop, stop!') – he reaches but stays behind the curb; chorus 'Stop! Look! Hold hands!'; step 1 STOP – 'Stop at the edge! Hands up, stop!' (copy-me: palms up); step 2 LOOK – 'Look this way! Look that way!' (copy-me: hand over the eyes, look both ways); step 3 HOLD HANDS – Daddy Tom kneels beside him and Jimmy puts his hand in Daddy's ('Hold Daddy's hand! Hold hands!'); he asks the viewer 'What do we do? Hmm?' (pause) – 'Stop! Look! Hold hands! Yay!'; lesson 'Hold hands to cross the street!'. Loop: the hook framing again, the street empty, the red ball safe in his arm, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Crossing the street: STOP at the edge, LOOK both ways, HOLD a grown-up's hand.
place: SUNNY PARK (reference image park.jpg) – the sidewalk at the park's edge beside a quiet empty street with a zebra crosswalk
calendar: Wednesday slot 2 – Safety (#1 was hot things on 4 Nov; today: hold hands crossing the street).
characters: BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue t-shirt with a small yellow star, navy blue shorts and white sneakers with yellow laces.

DADDY: a friendly young father in 3D Pixar style, short dark brown curly hair, a short neat dark brown beard, warm brown eyes, thick eyebrows, big happy smile. wearing a loose light green t-shirt, beige loose chino trousers and white sneakers.
setting: SUNNY PARK: a sunny park with a playground with a red slide and yellow swings, a small duck pond with white ducks and a little wooden bridge, a big green tree, a winding stone path, flower beds and a white bench. (+ light gray sidewalk, low curb, quiet empty street with white zebra stripes, no cars, no signs)

supporting_objects.ball: a shiny plain red ball (no pattern, no text)

learning.goal: Know the three steps for crossing the street: stop at the edge, look both ways, hold a grown-up's hand.
learning.shown_how: Shot 2 Jimmy stops at the curb with both palms up; shot 3 he looks one way and the other with a hand over his eyes; shot 4 he puts his hand in Daddy's hand. The ball rolls away across the empty street but Jimmy never steps off the curb.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18-0:21 'What do we do? Hmm?' + 0:21-0:23 humming pause (question boing) -> 0:23 'Stop! Look! Hold hands! Yay!' + cheer + confetti
learning.copy_me: 0:06 hands up STOP · 0:09 hand over the eyes, look this way and that way · clap on each word of the chorus
learning.fact_check: Standard toddler road-safety steps (stop at the curb, look both ways, hold a grown-up's hand). Empty street, no cars, no signs/text. Jimmy never steps onto the street alone; he only crosses holding Daddy's hand (implied), the ball is back in the loop.
learning.modeling: Jimmy does NOT run after the ball into the street – he stops at the curb, looks, and waits for Daddy's hand. Correct behaviour throughout.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, bright sunny park, nothing scary (no cars at all), big face, one baby + Daddy (Wed slot 2 allows one grown-up).

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: the ball bounces away toward the camera
say-it-with-me chorus: Stop! Look! Hold hands!
copy-me: palms up stop, look both ways
interactive pause: What do we do?
